_note: What it takes to be hired into each role, beyond skills (DECISIONS #43). 'usual' comes from the role's MASCO 2020 major group and is what employers usually ask for, not a rule: MASCO itself says the skills may also come from informal training and experience. 'licence' is a legal or official requirement to do the work; a role with one is never shown as a short next move unless it is the person's own job. Sources checked 22 Oct 2026; team: confirm each and fill reviewed_by (REVIEW_LOG.md).

registered_nurse.name: Registration with the Nursing Board Malaysia (Lembaga Jururawat Malaysia) and a yearly practising certificate
registered_nurse.route: An LJM-recognised Diploma in Nursing (3 years full time), then the LJM licensing examination

sources.title: Nurses Act 1950 (Act 14), as published by the Ministry of Health Nursing Division
Lembaga Jururawat Malaysia (Nursing Board Malaysia), Ministry of Health
IJN College, Diploma in Nursing: 3 years, then the LJM Licensing Examination

renewable_energy_technician.name: A wireman competency certificate from the Energy Commission (Suruhanjaya Tenaga) for electrical wiring work
renewable_energy_technician.route: An ST-accredited wireman course (PW2, about 2 years plus 6 months on the job at a skills college) and the ST competency examination

sources.title: Suruhanjaya Tenaga Directive 12/2026: what each certificate of competency (including Pendawai, wireman) allows, under the Electricity Regulations 1994
VTAR Institute, Wireman PW2 competency course (ST-accredited): 2 years + 6 months OJT

tvet_instructor.name: A Vocational Training Officer (VTO) certificate from the Department of Skills Development (JPK), to teach at JPK-accredited centres
tvet_instructor.law: Department of Skills Development (JPK) accreditation of skills training centres
tvet_instructor.route: A Malaysian Skills Certificate (SKM) Level 3 in your trade, then the VTO course at CIAST (about 9½ months: 3½ months of teaching methods and a 6-month internship)

sources.title: Department of Skills Development (JPK), Ministry of Human Resources
